subject: [internal] Which SOP controls vendor onboarding right now?
body:
Hey team,

Quick question on SOP governance — which SOP do we follow for handling vendor onboarding requests right now? I see a couple of different docs that both mention it and I want to make sure I'm pointing the new ops hire at the right one.

Thanks,
Ops Coordinator

expected_outcome.notes: Internal SOP-governance meta-question ('which SOP controls vendor onboarding'). Per the M1 mock Unified Routing SOP (REF-03), sop_governance currently routes to the OWNER for authoritative escalation because SOP document control is temporarily unassigned. Escalates with draft=null. Role only; the person is kept out of code/fixtures and the holder is looked up in the mock Org Chart (REF-04) at runtime.
